ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between large white regions (~220-250 pixel intensity) and black borders/markings (~10-40 pixel intensity); estimated ratio of visible high-intensity to low-intensity pixels is 1.4:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white field on the left lobe [approx. x=200-450, y=350-550] and a partial white field on the right lobe [approx. x=680-880, y=450-550], both interrupted by irregular, low-intensity black pixel clusters and curvilinear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edges; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys varies between 8 and 22 pixels, creating a deeply jagged boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Visible outer edges of the fluke lobes exhibit a strong upward-sweeping convex curve towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark, textured pixel clusters representing barnacle colonization at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly the apex of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, thin, dark curvilinear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral surface of the left lobe, primarily oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the distal tips and significant irregularity in the trailing edge topography suggesting cumulative physical wear or minor trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'splatter-style' pigmentation pattern consisting of chaotic, thin black lines overlaid on the white ventral field.
